title: Custom Clutch Inputsounds
body:
When you click or press the assigned hotkey, the configured .wav file will play.

Just like in the rhythm game osu!, you'll hear customizable hit sounds every time you click or press a key!!
There's absolutely no lag or stuttering, so you can use it with confidence!

All you have to do is enable sound in the mod settings within ModMenu and enter the path to the WAV file you want to play—and you're all set! Easy, right?

**Just copy and paste the path to the WAV file you want to play.**

**~~If you're not sure how to use it, contact me on Discord. “10_yum1_n”~~**

Prerequisite mod(Probably)
1. Fabric API
2. Mod Menu
3. Text Placeholder API
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
まあ、abyssal_mcって人が作ったclutchっていうmodの
GUI input soundsっていう機能の音変えれる版

**再生したいwavファイルのパスをコピーして貼り付けるだけです。**

**~~使い方がわからない場合は、Discordで私に連絡してください。「10_yum1_n」~~**
